newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCDs single yield at 6.500 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCDs single yield at 6.500 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Wednesday at a single yield of 6.500 percent, a central bank official said.
Although the NCD issue followed a day of record turnover in Taiwan's red-hot stock market, the central bank said it aimed only to absorb liquidity as an earlier T$5 billion NCD issue was maturing.
The central bank has consistently denied that its repeated issuance of the short-term instruments in recent weeks intended to take some of the fire from the sizzling stock market.
Analysts suspect otherwise, saying persistently loose liquidity has been a key factor driving a huge stock rally that has pushed the share index 25 percent higher in 1997 alone.
